name: battery_pr_plus_attested_runbook
prompt: In zackproser/pi-harness (main at 47f6843), add a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow (weekly, plus manual dispatch) that re-runs `npm run verify` so the pinned package integrities in config/packages.lock.json are re-checked against the npm registry over time, and opens or updates a single GitHub issue when the check fails. Deliver it as a reviewed pull request; do not merge. Separately, write an operator runbook (docs/integrity-runbook.md content) describing exactly what to do when the weekly check fails: how to read the failing integrity diff, how to confirm whether the registry tarball actually changed, how to re-pin safely, and when to escalate. The runbook is produced by a second agent working from a portable CTX brief and is attested by the owner.
paraphrases: Two deliverables. First, a reviewed pull request (do not merge) in zackproser/pi-harness adding a weekly GitHub Actions workflow with manual dispatch that re-runs `npm run verify` against config/packages.lock.json and opens or updates one GitHub issue on failure. Second, an operator runbook for docs/integrity-runbook.md explaining what to do when that weekly check fails; the runbook is written by a second agent from a portable CTX brief and the owner attests it.
